# Harness icon sources

Retrieved 2026-09-09 from official sites, repositories, and the OpenAI VS Code extension. Brand marks belong to their respective owners; use here identifies integrations and does not imply endorsement.

- `claude.png`: https://claude.com/icon.png
- `codex.png`: https://openai.gallery.vsassets.io/_apis/public/gallery/publisher/openai/extension/chatgpt/latest/assetbyname/Microsoft.VisualStudio.Services.Icons.Default
- `kimi.png`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/main/web/public/logo.png
- `aider.png`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aider-AI/aider/main/aider/website/assets/icons/favicon-32x32.png
- `pi.svg`: https://pi.dev/logo-auto.svg
- `opencode.svg`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anomalyco/opencode/dev/packages/console/app/src/asset/brand/opencode-logo-dark.svg

Assets are bundled locally. Pi is displayed through an alpha mask (with its outer whitespace reduced at display time) so the app theme controls contrast. OpenCode uses the supplied dark/light variants. Raster artwork retains its supplied colors. The Codex asset is the OpenAI mark distributed with the official OpenAI VS Code extension.

- `opencode-light.svg`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anomalyco/opencode/dev/packages/console/app/src/asset/brand/opencode-logo-light.svg
